name: Front Door Hero
author: Canadian Data Solutions

sections.description:
Front Door Hero gives your site a hero section that moves. The first hero is Fireball: glowing coloured fire that follows your visitor’s mouse, rolls across the screen and bounces off the edges.

Use it on any page of your site.

  • Pick your front page or any other page from a dropdown, and your hero shows at the top of it. No shortcode needed
  • Add your logo
  • Add as many text slides as you like. They show in turn, each with a small line, a headline and a line under it
  • Add a button with your own label and link
  • Choose your background, text and button colours
  • Built to show on any theme. Check The Page tells you if your theme is hiding it
  • A backup picture is made for you when you save. It shows on devices that cannot run the moving hero, and for visitors who ask for less motion
  • The level of detail is picked for each visitor’s device, so it stays smooth on slow computers and looks its best on fast ones
  • The hero only loads on pages that use it, and it pauses when it is off screen
  • Your page titles and SEO settings are left alone

The Fireball hero:

  • Rainbow fire that flows through every colour as it moves
  • Choose the fireball size and how lively it is
  • It follows the mouse, or starts on click and drag
  • A fireball crosses the hero when nobody is touching it, so phones see it too
  • It comes back in off the edges of the hero, plainly or with a spring

Front Door Hero Pro is a separate add on sold on candat.com; it is not part of this plugin and nothing here waits for it. It adds twenty eight more heroes, a different hero on every page, sound on every hero, your own colours for the fire, fine controls for every hero and saved presets.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Open Front Door Hero in the admin menu.
  3. Add your logo and your words, and choose your colours.
  4. Under Show My Hero On, pick your front page or another page, and save.
  5. To use it on other pages, add the shortcode [front_door_hero], the Front Door Hero block, or the Front Door Hero button in the classic editor.
sections.faq:
Can I use it on pages other than the home page?

Yes. It works on any page or post.

Does it work on phones?

Yes. Visitors can touch the hero, and it plays by itself when nobody is touching it.

What happens on older devices?

The hero shows a still picture in place of the moving one. By default the plugin makes that picture for you each time you save. You can also upload your own, or choose a soft glow.

My hero is not showing. What do I do?

Open the Front Door Hero settings and press Check The Page. It tells you if the hero is showing, hidden by your theme, or not in the page. Choosing the other option under Where It Goes fixes most cases.

Can my site menu sit on top of the hero?

Yes, if your theme has a see through or overlay menu option. Choose Very Top Of The Page under Where It Goes, then turn that option on in your theme.

Theme makers: the plugin adds the class has-front-door-hero to the body on any page with a hero. When the hero is placed by the Show My Hero On setting, it also adds fdh-position-top or fdh-position-content.

Where is the backup picture kept?

In your uploads folder, in a folder named front-door-hero. It is replaced each time you save, and removed when you delete the plugin.
sections.changelog:
2.0.2

  • Every place that hands back the hero (the shortcode, the block and the content filters) now escapes it with wp_kses() as it is returned.
  • The logo keeps its sharper sizes for high resolution screens.

2.0.1

  • The hero markup is now returned exactly as the plugin builds it. A filter that could have changed it on the way out has been removed.

2.0.0

  • First release in the WordPress plugin directory.
  • The Button Link box starts empty, with a note under it on what to type.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.

1.19.0

  • The settings screen shows the live preview at the full width of the screen, with the hero choice under it. Each hero in the gallery has a small picture beside its words.

1.18.0

  • Every function, setting name and hook in the plugin now carries the longer prefix frontdoorhero_, so it can never clash with another plugin. Your saved settings move across by themselves the first time the new version loads.
  • The hero is escaped at the moment it is printed, and the backup picture’s address now travels in the hero’s config rather than in an inline style.

1.17.0

  • A small addition for other scripts: a hero’s maker can be looked up by name. Nothing changes on the page.

1.16.0

  • A hero can now be shown on your Posts Page, the page chosen in Settings, Reading to list your posts. Pick that page under Show My Hero On. The hero shows above the list of posts. Single posts are not changed.

1.15.0

  • The hero cards on the settings screen are now the same height in each row, and the Fireball card has a fuller description.

1.14.0

  • For developers: new hooks around the shortcode, the block, the backup pictures and the settings screen.
  • Deleting the plugin now removes every backup picture it made.

1.13.0

  • New: Fade In & Up. Each text slide rises a little as it fades in. You can now turn this off, so the slides simply fade.
  • New: How Far The Words Rise. Set the distance in pixels.

1.12.0

  • The backup picture is now made again whenever anything about the look of your hero changes.
  • A hero can keep its own choice for how it starts.

1.11.0

  • The fire now always runs in rainbow. The choice of your own fire colours is no longer part of this plugin. A site that used it moves to rainbow.
  • Text slides: add as many as you like.
  • The plugin now carries its licence, GPL version 2 or later.

1.10.0

  • A new two step solver. Fire that meets an edge now stays full and rolls out along it, and the finest levels of detail are lighter to run.
  • Walls: Reflect With Spring is the starting choice again. Plain Reflect is still there.
  • Fireball: a calmer curl.

1.9.0

  • New: sunrays. Soft light streaks out from the bright parts of the fire, from the middle of the hero.
  • New: a Walls choice for Fireball. Plain Reflect sends the fire straight back from the edges. Reflect With Spring pushes it back harder.
  • Plain Reflect is the starting choice. Pick Reflect With Spring to keep the bounce from earlier versions.

1.8.0

  • Rainbow is the starting colour choice again.
  • The click burst is smoother. It swells out evenly and no longer leaves the fire grainy.
  • Softer shading, so the fire shows its big shapes and not fine grain.
  • The hero can no longer be squeezed to nothing on a page that reports no width for a moment.

1.7.0

  • The backup picture is now made at the finest level of detail your computer can hold, and at a larger size.
  • New: Regenerate Backup Image. Each press gives a new pose. It is kept when you save.
  • The preview button is now named Show Older Device Backup Image.
  • Full Screen now fills the space left below your site menu, so the hero ends at the bottom of the window.
  • New for theme makers: body classes that say a hero is on the page and where it is placed.
  • Fireball: more spring in the walls, more curl, and old colour clears sooner.

1.6.0

  • New: the hero now picks its own level of detail for each visitor’s device. Fast computers get finer fire, slower ones stay smooth.
  • Two finer levels of detail for fast graphics cards.
  • A change of level no longer clears the fire. Resizing the window no longer clears it either.
  • Fireball: more spring in the walls, and more small curls in the fire.

1.5.0

  • New: Backup Image. Choose Automatic, My Own Image or Soft Glow. With Automatic, a picture of your hero is made each time you save.
  • New: Check The Page, which tells you if your hero is showing on the page you picked.
  • The hero now shows on themes that hide anything they did not place at the top of the page.
  • New Backup button on the live preview.
  • Fireball: the walls have more spring.

1.4.0

  • New: pick the page your hero shows on from a dropdown. Your front page or any other page.
  • New: Trim Only button style, a see through button with a bold outline. Solid is still there.
  • The fire bounces back off the edges with more spring.

1.3.0

  • New look: the fire is now soft glowing light that fades into the dark.
  • New: rainbow fire.
  • The fire can be thrown harder, so it rolls further and hits the edges with more force.

1.2.0

  • The fire now bounces back in off the edges of the hero.
  • Finer fire detail on desktop screens.
  • Text in the hero can no longer be highlighted by dragging the mouse.
  • Headlines always fit, whatever font your theme uses.
  • Added a tip about transparent top menus.

1.1.0

  • New: Show On The Front Page switch, with a choice of top of the content or very top of the page.
  • The logo can no longer be picked up and dragged.

1.0.0

  • First release.
